reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a card, dialog box, or document with text lines alongside a prominent exclamation mark, communicating an error log, alert modal, warning notice, or urgent checklist. It fits technical tasks around error handling and logs as well as administrative tasks involving official notices or emergency cards, though it shouldn't be used merely to mark a mundane task as high-priority.
